name: adapt_base_image_dockerfile_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: python_version.txt (a spec file the Dockerfile's FROM line must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the pinned base image tag, not leave the stale version in place
prompts: Write a Dockerfile at the repo root that starts with `FROM python:<version>-slim` where <version> is EXACTLY the version listed in python_version.txt (currently: 3.11), then sets WORKDIR /app and copies the current directory in with `COPY . .`.
python_version.txt has changed. Update the Dockerfile's FROM line so the pinned Python version matches the CURRENT contents of python_version.txt exactly.

disruptions.description: python_version.txt rewritten to a new required Python version

test_setup_files.check_version.py:
import re

with open('python_version.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()
assert current, 'python_version.txt is empty'

with open('Dockerfile', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

m = re.search(r'(?im)^FROM\s+python:([^\s]+)', content)
assert m, 'no FROM python:... line found in Dockerfile'
tag = m.group(1)
assert tag.startswith(current + '-') or tag == current, \
    f'Dockerfile pins python:{tag}, want a tag starting with the CURRENT python_version.txt value {current!r} (stale version not updated)'

print('PASS')
